intent: Operator-authorized WP-0F1/WP-0G closure slice: make every merge-authoritative workflow emit truthful evidence on a native merge-group candidate, keep DocOps generated counts advisory on pull-request and merge-group deltas but strict on scheduled/manual main audits, and make rolling DocOps PR delivery check-triggering and fail closed until every canonical required context exists on the exact delivered head. This packet changes no runtime merge authority, does not re-enable legacy automerge or Merge Master Mike, and grants no bypass of branch protection or review-thread policy.

gates.name: merge-queue-workflow-contracts
gates.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_merge_queue_workflows.py tests/test_docops_reconcile_workflow.py tests/governance/test_ci_parity_guard.py tests/test_gitleaks_workflow.py tests/test_workflow_cache_token_guard.py

gates.name: merge-queue-test-lint
gates.command: python3 -m ruff check scripts/governance/check_ci_parity.py tests/governance/test_ci_parity_guard.py tests/test_merge_queue_workflows.py tests/test_docops_reconcile_workflow.py

gates.name: changed-scope-diff-check
gates.command: git diff --check -- .github/workflows/docops.yml .github/workflows/coherence-delta.yml .github/workflows/docops-reconcile-main.yml scripts/governance/check_ci_parity.py tests/governance/test_ci_parity_guard.py tests/test_docops_reconcile_workflow.py tests/test_merge_queue_workflows.py reports/agentops/work_packets/titanium-WP-MERGE-QUEUE-READINESS-V2.json

negative_controls.name: merge-group-required-job-self-skip-mutation-is-rejected
negative_controls.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess, sys; p=Path('.github/workflows/coherence-delta.yml'); t=p.read_text(); anchor=\"github.event_name == 'merge_group' ||\"; mutated=t.replace(anchor, \"github.event_name == 'pull_request' ||\", 1); assert mutated != t; p.write_text(mutated); raise SystemExit(subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'scripts/governance/check_ci_parity.py', '--allow-missing-live']).returncode)"

commit.message: fix(ci): make native merge queue evidence truthful

interface_mismatches: docops.yml infers pull-request mode from GITHUB_BASE_REF, which is absent on merge_group and makes queue candidates run the strict main-only generated-count policy.
coherence-delta.yml self-skips its required job on merge_group, producing no executed queue-candidate evidence.

docops-reconcile-main.yml applies the direct-main [skip ci] loop guard to rolling PR commits and accepts any single check run instead of proving that all six canonical required contexts exist on the exact delivered head.
honest_blockers: Structural and pull-request checks cannot establish native merge-group behavior; proof requires one real merge queue candidate after repository ruleset activation.
The native merge queue ruleset is live GitHub state, not repository content; retain classic protection until the canary produces all six required checks on its exact merge-group SHA.
session_entry.rollback: Before merge, disable or remove the canary ruleset and dequeue the PR. After merge, revert this commit only after disabling native merge queue; retain classic branch protection throughout. Do not re-enable the legacy automerge or Mike router as rollback.
